function.name: get_values
function.description: Official figures for a US statistical series exactly as published on a given date (the vintage in force on as_of). Returns, for each period from start_period to end_period: the value, the change from the prior period, the percent change from the prior month (monthly series) or the annualized growth rate (GDPC1), and the percent change from a year earlier, all as published on as_of.

start_period.description: First period: YYYY-MM for monthly series, YYYYQn for GDPC1.

end_period.description: Last period, same format. Omit for a single period.

as_of.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD; the figures returned are those published on or before this date.
